canonical_title: Antiskid control system in environmental conditions

versions.title_at_revision: Antiskid control system in environmental conditions
versions.text:
Standard: The integrated brake control, antiskid and brake systems function in the installed environment and heat buildup does not cause locked wheels, loss of brake function during braking events. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Conduct ground testing on air vehicle to verify that the brake control, antiskid and brake systems are compatible and can function in the installed environment without impacting the stopping performance (e.g., locked wheels and loss of braking) of the air vehicle. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that the brake control, antiskid and brake systems are compatible and can function in the installed environment without impacting the stopping performance (e.g., locked wheels and loss of braking) of the air vehicle.
